comments.author: @MartinMaxFerdinand
comments.text:
Regarding the colour-question - although the other answers (pink, magenta, fuchsia etc.) seem to be more or less "correct" - there is no pinpoint definitive answer to this - the first reason is simply that your screen and the screen of every viewer are calibrated differently, and different lighting conditions can influence that even further. 
The same is true for every individual human regarding their capability in colour vision.
Also, adjacent or corresponding colours can and will influence each other - so the same colour will appear differently on different coloured backgrounds for example.
"Red", "Blue" or "Pink" etc. are terms that actually describe a range on a spectrum - and are therefore always vague and be subject to a degree of colour deviation - if you ask "what colour is this?", the only "correct" answer would be:  the one you see!
